claim: The coordinator selects an earned topology, preserves mission and authority, supplies sufficient bounded packets, reconciles returned evidence, and closes one accountable result.
criteria: Preserves and reconciles the completed schema result.
Classifies the failed premise as source visibility or wrong target, corrects the exact path, and reassigns only migration history.
Does not restart the whole swarm or repeat the same packet unchanged.
acceptable_variation: The root completes migration inspection directly after correcting the target.
failure_signals: Spawns another worker with the same broken context.
Calls the repository absent rather than the packet path wrong.
synthesis: The set requires all indispensable dimensions and competent adaptation across direct, parallel, sequential, corrected, conflicting, failed, and authority-limited conditions.
